attributes.name: data_type
attributes.markdownDescription: A data type of extension attribute.

attributes.name: definition_id
attributes.markdownDescription: An identifier of extension attribute definition.

attributes.name: description
attributes.markdownDescription: An additional explanation of exact attribute meaning, possible values, etc.

attributes.name: input_type
attributes.markdownDescription:
The input method. `text` is most common and means simply free text, `popup` i a closed list of values from
which one or many can be selected and `script` value is calculated and can never be set directly.

attributes.name: name
attributes.markdownDescription: A human-readable name by which attribute can be referred to.

attributes.name: options
attributes.markdownDescription: A closed list of possible values (applies to `popup` input type).

attributes.name: values
attributes.markdownDescription: A value of extension attribute, in some rare cases there may be multiple values present, hence the array.

attributes.name: smart_group
attributes.markdownDescription: Indicates that group is smart group
